purpose: Discover short posts about coding-agent workflows, then verify technical claims in primary documentation or source code.

method.query_limit: Twelve targeted web queries across three calls. Each call had four queries or fewer.
method.access: Public search results and public transcript mirrors only. Direct TikTok access was blocked by robots rules. No logins, cookies, paid providers, or browser tools were used.
method.video_access: No video was watched. Three distinct TikTok video URLs had identifiable titles, authors, dates, and public transcript or caption text through third-party mirrors. The mirrors are not TikTok. Their counts are not treated as verified viral rankings.
method.verification: Technical claims in the chapter use the official Git manual, current Claude Code docs, Anthropic's first-hand system report, and TikTok Effect House docs. TikTok posts supplied discovery leads and creator reports only.
method.selection: Selected posts that describe concrete team or subagent mechanisms and include a testable limit. A creator's anecdote is labeled as such. The chapter does not infer broad quality or speed from views or likes.
